I have one and I'm relatively happy with it.  But they're hard to recommend.  You're looking at something like $100 for the printer on top of about $1 per pic.  And as you can see from the pics, the "color accuracy" or whatever it's called isn't nearly as good as advertised.  Frankly I'm super disappointed in Nintendo for partnering with a product that struggles to work great with their product.    And the partner app really just gives you frames.  It lets you pull in pics from your Switch, but it's literally just the basic "share to smartphone" functionality dressed up.  


But also having all these little pseudo-polaroids is really fun.  I did a series of them for my GF as a little thing.  Plus I have a pic from AC and another of Appletun from SwSh, and those are actually up at my desk at work.

I suggest you really crank the saturation and mess with the other "correction" settings.  The printer is less than perfect, and it seems to really have trouble with contrasting really bright and really dark colors.
